novelty.justification: The claim hypothesizes that “agent-attributed belief states are encoded along partially separable, causally-manipulable directions distinct from the model's own factual-veracity direction” and, more specifically, that Theory-of-Mind failures arise from “collapse or entanglement” between those representations, making the novelty route a new mechanistic relationship rather than merely a new setting. Searches using “LLM agent attributed belief activation geometry,” “mechanistic interpretability false belief theory of mind,” “belief attribution linear probes steering,” and “self other belief representations language models” found behavioral ToM studies and Are Explicit Belief Representations Necessary? (2025), truth-direction work such as Probing the Geometry of Truth (2025), and persona activation-patching work, but none establishes agent-specific belief directions or links their alignment with factual representations to reality-biased errors. Moving from those works to the proposed attribution-versus-veracity geometry requires a new core relationship, not a direct transfer, although the probes, steering, and subspace-overlap measurements are standard tools; this supports high novelty within the established mechanistic-interpretability framework rather than paradigm-level novelty.
